name: Zhuogui Gansheng Dui
source:
To break your curse, you must face the four most terrifying female ghosts in history! Yet they’re not quite like the rumors say...? During nightly explorations, find ways to tame them and suppress their ghostly aura. The true key to victory lies below your waist♂!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4103150]Steam[/url]]
